441	    /// Writes the waveform for `media` to `cache/peaks/<id>.bin`: the
442	    /// reader's every sample buffer through `PeakBuckets`
443	    /// (`MediaPeakBuckets.swift`), then one atomic write of its floats after
444	    /// successful whole-track coverage.
445	    ///
446	    /// Skipped when `peaks/<id>.complete.json` holds `PeaksStamp(stamp)` AND
447	    /// its `.bin` is valid — the marker is a sibling, not a child, so either can be
448	    /// deleted without the other. Otherwise BOTH go, before anything below
449	    /// can fail, and a removed `.bin` is posted at once (`clearPeaks` says
450	    /// why: readers may memoize a waveform, so a withdrawal must invalidate
451	    /// it). No track, unusable extent, reader failure or incomplete decode
452	    /// writes no marker or `.bin`; `generateCaches` retries it in the same
453	    /// session (`retryPeaks`). Answers true when there is nothing to make or
454	    /// the waveform is current or published, false otherwise — a superseded
455	    /// pass included. A media with no audio (a relink to a silent file, #180)
456	    /// withdraws and posts a `.bin` still on disk the same way, while current.
457	    @discardableResult
458	    static func peaks(
459	        for media: MediaSnapshot, url: URL, stamp: CacheStamp?, into cacheDir: URL,
460	        pass: CachePass? = nil
461	    ) async -> Bool {
462	        guard media.hasAudio, media.duration > 0 else {
463	            if pass?.isCurrent() ?? true, clearPeaks(for: media.id, in: cacheDir) {
464	                postCacheChange(media: media.id, kind: peaksKind)
465	            }
466	            return true
467	        }
468	        if peaksAreCurrent(for: media, stamp: stamp, in: cacheDir) { return true }
469	        guard pass?.isCurrent() ?? true else { return false }
470	        if clearPeaks(for: media.id, in: cacheDir) {
471	            postCacheChange(media: media.id, kind: peaksKind)
472	        }
473	        let asset = AVURLAsset(url: url)
474	        guard let track = (try? await asset.loadTracks(withMediaType: .audio))?.first else {
475	            return false
476	        }
477	        guard let trackRange = try? await track.load(.timeRange),
478	            let segments = try? await track.load(.segments),
479	            let expected = expectedPeaksRanges(trackRange: trackRange, segments: segments)
480	        else { return false }
481	        return await onCacheLane {
482	            writePeaks(for: media, asset: asset, track: track, expectedRanges: expected,
483	                       stamp: stamp, into: cacheDir, pass: pass)
484	        }
485	    }

515	    /// Writes `cache/sync/<id>.bin` — Synchronize Audio's MFCC frames (spec
516	    /// §11 SY-11; `MediaImporter+SyncFeatures.swift` is the reader and the
517	    /// marker), run after `peaks` and before `speech`, and once more by
518	    /// `retryPeaks` after an attempt that lands the waveform. `speech`'s
519	    /// posture with no posts and no model: no audio clears what is on disk
520	    /// (while current); a current marker skips; a stale one is cleared first.

522	        for media: MediaSnapshot, url: URL, stamp: CacheStamp?, into cacheDir: URL,
523	        pass: CachePass? = nil
524	    ) async {

526	            if pass?.isCurrent() ?? true { clearSyncFeatures(for: media.id, in: cacheDir) }
527	            return
528	        }
529	        guard !syncFeaturesAreCurrent(for: media, stamp: stamp, in: cacheDir) else { return }
530	        guard pass?.isCurrent() ?? true else { return }
531	        clearSyncFeatures(for: media.id, in: cacheDir)
532	        let asset = AVURLAsset(url: url)
533	        guard let track = (try? await asset.loadTracks(withMediaType: .audio))?.first else {
534	            return
535	        }

544	    /// Writes `cache/speech/<id>.bin` — road map 4's voice cache, run AFTER
545	    /// `peaks` in `generateCaches`'s order (never before it), so the `.bin`

547	    /// decode and an inference pass.

549	    /// Skipped when `speechIsCurrent` (`MediaImporter+Speech.swift`'s head
550	    /// check) says the marker, the model and the chunk size all still agree,

552	    /// posts a `.bin` left on disk as below (#180). A stale cache is cleared
553	    /// and posted at once — `clearSpeech`'s doc argues the order — and that
554	    /// withdrawal is the first post of a pass replacing a `.bin` on disk, so
555	    /// it carries `replaced` (§4g claim 14), the one way it differs from
556	    /// `peaks`'. Then `SileroVAD.isAvailable` is asked exactly once: a model
557	    /// already marked unavailable this process (a nil bundle, an earlier
558	    /// thrown prediction) is not retried, so a project full of media pays for
559	    /// it once, not per file.
560	    static func speech(
561	        for media: MediaSnapshot, url: URL, stamp: CacheStamp?, into cacheDir: URL,
562	        pass: CachePass? = nil
563	    ) async {
564	        guard media.hasAudio, media.duration > 0 else {
565	            if pass?.isCurrent() ?? true, clearSpeech(for: media.id, in: cacheDir) {
566	                postCacheChange(media: media.id, kind: speechKind, replaced: true)
567	            }
568	            return
569	        }
570	        guard !speechIsCurrent(for: media, stamp: stamp, in: cacheDir) else { return }
571	        guard pass?.isCurrent() ?? true else { return }
572	        if clearSpeech(for: media.id, in: cacheDir) {
573	            postCacheChange(media: media.id, kind: speechKind, replaced: true)
574	        }
575	        guard SileroVAD.isAvailable else { return }
576	        let asset = AVURLAsset(url: url)
577	        guard let track = (try? await asset.loadTracks(withMediaType: .audio))?.first else {
578	            return
579	        }
580	        await onCacheLane {
581	            writeSpeech(for: media, asset: asset, track: track, stamp: stamp,
582	                        into: cacheDir, pass: pass)
583	        }
584	    }

6	/// The await-free half of `MediaImporter`: the refusal type, the still-image
7	/// question, the ImageIO probe of a still, and the rate table
8	/// `rationalFrameRate` rounds a track's float onto. It also holds the
9	/// probe's synchronous faces (`probe(url:mayAsk:completion:)`,
10	/// `probeAllowingRewrap`, `probeBlocking`, with `withoutAsking`), which wait through `waitForProbe`. Nothing here touches
11	/// AVFoundation's loading API — every `await` is in `MediaImporter.swift`,
12	/// the one file that may (app/CLAUDE.md) — and every member keeps its
13	/// `MediaImporter.` spelling at every call site, so the cut is invisible from
14	/// outside: it exists because road map 3's held tail took the base file over
15	/// the ~600-line cap, and the members that owe nothing to the seam are the
16	/// ones that could leave. `MediaCacheFiles.swift` is the same shape for the
17	/// cache half.
18	extension MediaImporter {
19	
20	    // MARK: - Errors
21	
22	    /// Import refusals. Every one is shown in an alert and never crashes;
23	    /// `unreadable` is also what a relink of a moved file reports.
24	    enum ImportError: LocalizedError {
25	        case unreadable(URL)
26	        case noTracks(URL)
27	        case timedOut(URL)
28	        /// The video track's first frame will not decode here (spec §11
29	        /// #216); the sentence names the codec (`DecoderSupport.refusal`).
30	        case undecodable(URL, sentence: String)
31	
32	        var errorDescription: String? {
33	            switch self {
34	            case .unreadable(let url):
35	                return "Could not read \(url.lastPathComponent)."
36	            case .noTracks(let url):
37	                return "\(url.lastPathComponent) has no video or audio the app can open."
38	            case .timedOut(let url):
39	                return "Timed out reading \(url.lastPathComponent)."
40	            case .undecodable(_, let sentence):
41	                return sentence
42	            }
43	        }
44	
45	        /// Whether a user-installed ffmpeg is worth offering (`FFmpegRewrap`).
46	        ///
47	        /// `unreadable` is the one that matters: AVFoundation answers a
48	        /// Matroska or a WebM with `AVFoundationErrorDomain -11828 "Cannot
49	        /// Open"` on the *container*, before it has looked at the codecs
50	        /// inside, so a plain H.264 recording in an `.mkv` lands here and is
51	        /// one stream copy away from importing. `noTracks` is included
52	        /// because a container AVFoundation half-understands can report a
53	        /// duration and no tracks; `FFmpegRewrap.plan` refuses a file that
54	        /// genuinely has no video and no audio, so a truly empty one keeps
55	        /// this message. `timedOut` is not: a stalled network mount will
56	        /// stall ffmpeg too, and the second wait is not a kindness. Nor is
57	        /// `undecodable`: the refusal is final (spec §11 #216).
58	        var invitesFFmpeg: Bool {
59	            switch self {
60	            case .unreadable, .noTracks: return true
61	            case .timedOut, .undecodable: return false
62	            }
63	        }
64	    }
65	
66	    // MARK: - Stills
67	
68	    /// Still-image types ImageIO decodes and AVFoundation would refuse.
69	    /// Probed with ImageIO and imported as `kind: image` (§7.7).
70	    static let imageTypes: [UTType] = [.png, .jpeg, .heic, .heif, .tiff, .gif, .bmp, .webP]
71	
72	    /// Whether `url` is a still picture rather than a movie. Type-based, not
73	    /// extension-based, so a `.heic` written by a camera and a `.jpeg` with
74	    /// no extension both land in the same branch.
75	    static func isImage(_ url: URL) -> Bool {
76	        guard let type = UTType(filenameExtension: url.pathExtension.lowercased()) else {
77	            return false
78	        }
79	        return imageTypes.contains { type.conforms(to: $0) }
80	    }
81	
82	    /// ImageIO's view of a still: pixel size, and alpha from the file's own
83	    /// properties. Duration 0 — an `image` clip has no source bound and any
84	    /// duration (§5.2).
85	    static func probeImage(_ url: URL) throws -> MediaDescriptor {
86	        guard let source = CGImageSourceCreateWithURL(url as CFURL, nil),
87	            CGImageSourceGetCount(source) > 0,
88	            let props = CGImageSourceCopyPropertiesAtIndex(source, 0, nil) as? [CFString: Any]
89	        else {
90	            throw ImportError.unreadable(url)
91	        }
92	        let width = (props[kCGImagePropertyPixelWidth] as? Int) ?? 0
93	        let height = (props[kCGImagePropertyPixelHeight] as? Int) ?? 0
94	        guard width > 0, height > 0 else { throw ImportError.unreadable(url) }
95	        let hasAlpha = (props[kCGImagePropertyHasAlpha] as? Bool) ?? false
96	        // `hasVideo` is true for a still: it contributes pixels, so
97	        // `enabled.video` means something on its clips. It still gets NO
98	        // composition track — the recipe names an image layer `image`, not
99	        // `track` (§7.2), and the plan never lists it.
100	        var descriptor = MediaDescriptor(
101	            path: url.path, bookmark: bookmarkString(for: url), kind: .image, duration: 0,
102	            width: width, height: height, fps: .thirty, hasVideo: true, hasAudio: false,
103	            hasAlpha: hasAlpha)
104	        // A PQ still's peak, as a PQ video's (spec §11 HD-20 (b)).
105	        descriptor.color = detectedStillPQ(url)
106	        return descriptor
107	    }

109	    // MARK: - Rates
110	
111	    /// The rates a container is allowed to round: the integer rates and the
112	    /// three NTSC /1001 rates (§7.7). Anything else keeps three decimals as
113	    /// `[round(fps × 1000), 1000]`, which is exact enough to place source
114	    /// frames and never pretends a 47.3 fps screen recording is 48.
115	    static let commonRates: [Fps] = [
116	        Fps(num: 24, den: 1), Fps(num: 24000, den: 1001), Fps(num: 25, den: 1),
117	        Fps(num: 30, den: 1), Fps(num: 30000, den: 1001), Fps(num: 48, den: 1),
118	        Fps(num: 50, den: 1), Fps(num: 60, den: 1), Fps(num: 60000, den: 1001),
119	    ]
120	
121	    /// Tolerance for that match, in frames per second. 0.01 is wide enough
122	    /// for a float's error at 60 fps and narrower than the 0.03 gap between
123	    /// 29.97 and 30 — the pair this must never confuse.
124	    static let rateTolerance = 0.01
125	
126	    static func rationalFrameRate(_ nominal: Double) -> Fps {
127	        guard nominal.isFinite, nominal > 0 else { return .thirty }
128	        for candidate in commonRates where abs(candidate.double - nominal) <= rateTolerance {
129	            return candidate
130	        }
131	        return Fps(num: Int((nominal * 1000).rounded()), den: 1000)
132	    }
133	
134	    // MARK: - The synchronous faces
135	
136	    /// The longest `waitForProbe` waits for one AVFoundation probe.
137	    static let probeTimeout: TimeInterval = 30
138	
139	    /// The queue the completion-handler face probes on. A serial queue, not
140	    /// the cooperative pool: a conversion (`FFmpegRewrap`) blocks its thread
141	    /// for as long as ffmpeg runs, which is exactly what a cooperative
142	    /// thread must never do, and serialising means a batch drop of four
143	    /// unreadable files asks four questions in order rather than stacking
144	    /// four alerts. `app/CLAUDE.md` names import as one of the documented
145	    /// `DispatchQueue` seams.
146	    private static let importQueue = DispatchQueue(
147	        label: "com.kgalligan.framejob.import", qos: .userInitiated)
148	
149	    /// The synchronous face of `probe` for the rest of the app: the result
150	    /// arrives on the main thread, so the caller can go straight to
151	    /// `add_media` + `add_clip` without ever writing `await`. `mayAsk` is
152	    /// the caller's: true for a person's click, false for a tool call's.
153	    /// `watch` is too: a click door's sees a WebM or Matroska copy start
154	    /// (spec §11 #228-P), and a tool call passes none.
155	    static func probe(
156	        url: URL, mayAsk: Bool, watch: RewrapWatch? = nil,
157	        completion: @escaping (Result<MediaDescriptor, any Error>) -> Void
158	    ) {
159	        importQueue.async {
160	            let outcome = Result { try probeAllowingRewrap(url, mayAsk: mayAsk, watch: watch) }
161	            DispatchQueue.main.async { completion(outcome) }
162	        }
163	    }
164	
165	    /// The AVFoundation probe plus spec §11's opt-in ffmpeg step, and the
166	    /// body of both synchronous faces.
167	    ///
168	    /// The two halves are deliberately not nested inside `probe(url:)`.
169	    /// `waitForProbe` puts a 30-second ceiling (`probeTimeout`) on
170	    /// AVFoundation, which is right for reading headers and catastrophically
171	    /// wrong for a transcode; `FFmpegRewrap.assist` therefore runs OUTSIDE
172	    /// it, under its own bounds (`FFmpegRewrap.longestAssist`), and its
173	    /// result is probed with a fresh ceiling of its own. `assist` also needs
174	    /// the main thread for its consent alert, which it can only have because
175	    /// this function's callers are never the thread being waited on.
176	    ///
177	    /// Every one of the four import paths funnels through here — document
178	    /// open (`ProjectDocument.readMediaFile`), File ▸ Add Media… and Finder
179	    /// drops (`ProjectDocument.probeNext`), and the agent's `import_media`
180	    /// (`AgentServer+Media.probe`) — so an MKV opens the same way in all of
181	    /// them, and `assist` answering `nil` leaves all four with exactly the
182	    /// failure they report on a machine that has no ffmpeg. The built-in
183	    /// copy records the file it was made from as the descriptor's
184	    /// `original` (spec §11 #228-O), on every door alike, and so does an
185	    /// ffmpeg conversion (#233).
186	    ///
187	    /// **Who may be asked is decided by the caller** (spec §11 MC-5), never
188	    /// read from process-wide state: each place a tool call hands work to the
189	    /// importer passes `mayAsk: false` (`import_media`, `relink_media`,
190	    /// `record_screen`) or wraps its open in `withoutAsking` (`open_project`),
191	    /// and every click path passes `true`, so a person's own import still
192	    /// asks while a tool call runs.
193	    ///
194	    /// **Known cost of the document-open path.** NSDocumentController reads
195	    /// a person's File ▸ Open or Finder double-click on its concurrent read
196	    /// queue (`canConcurrentlyReadDocuments`), so the main thread is free
197	    /// for the built-in copy's progress window, which `watch` feeds and
198	    /// whose Cancel stops the copy (spec §11 #228-P; `probeForOpening`
199	    /// passes it there). An agent's `open_project` reads on the lane's
200	    /// thread inside `withoutAsking` (spec §11 #231), where no watch is
201	    /// passed: main is free, and the call waits the copy's length with no
202	    /// window. A read AppKit itself runs ON main passes no watch either, and
203	    /// there a copy — or an ffmpeg conversion, on any door, which reports no
204	    /// progress — blocks the window for its length; ffmpeg's consent alert
205	    /// states the cost first.
206	    private static func probeAllowingRewrap(
207	        _ url: URL, mayAsk: Bool, watch: RewrapWatch?
208	    ) throws -> MediaDescriptor {
209	        do {
210	            return withCursorBeside(try waitForProbe(url), movie: url)  // spec §11 CU-34 (a)
211	        } catch let failure as ImportError where failure.invitesFFmpeg && !isImage(url) {
212	            // Images are excluded because ImageIO's refusal means the picture
213	            // is corrupt, not that the container is exotic — and a PNG is not
214	            // something to hand to a video converter.
215	            guard ContainerRewrap.isMatroska(url) else {
216	                return try probeConverted(url, failure: failure, mayAsk: mayAsk)
217	            }
218	            // A WebM or Matroska file is copied into a movie with no question
219	            // (spec §11 #216-R). Only a codec the copy cannot carry goes on
220	            // to the opt-in ffmpeg step; every other refusal is final.
221	            do {
222	                return try probeCopy(try ContainerRewrap.assist(url, watch: watch), of: url)
223	            } catch let refusal as ContainerRewrapError where refusal.invitesFFmpeg {
224	                return try probeConverted(url, failure: refusal, mayAsk: mayAsk)
225	            }
226	        }
227	    }
228	
229	    /// The opt-in ffmpeg step, and its result probed, with `url` recorded as
230	    /// its `original` (spec §11 #233); `failure` is what is thrown when there
231	    /// is no conversion or it will not open. `mayAsk` is the caller's (spec
232	    /// §11 MC-5): a tool call's is false, so it never raises the consent
233	    /// question.
234	    ///
235	    /// There is ONE second attempt (spec §11 #227): when ffmpeg failed, a
236	    /// VP9 copy failed its frame check, or the file will not open, the step
237	    /// is asked again to re-encode a VP9 stream it had copied, with the
238	    /// first attempt's plan. A source whose plan copied no VP9 gets no
239	    /// second call, and then the first attempt's error is the one thrown. A
240	    /// timeout is not tried again.
241	    private static func probeConverted(
242	        _ url: URL, failure: any Error, mayAsk: Bool
243	    ) throws -> MediaDescriptor {
244	        var remembered = failure
245	        var converted: URL?
246	        var failed = false
247	        var planned: FFmpegRewrap.Plan?
248	        do {
249	            converted = try FFmpegRewrap.assist(url, mayAsk: mayAsk, planned: &planned)
250	        } catch let refusal as FFmpegRewrap.RewrapError {
251	            guard case .failed = refusal else { throw refusal }
252	            (remembered, failed) = (refusal, true)
253	        }
254	        if let converted {
255	            if let descriptor = probeConversion(converted, of: url) { return descriptor }
256	        } else if !failed {
257	            throw failure
258	        }
259	        if let planned, !planned.copiesVP9 { throw remembered }
260	        guard
261	            let again = try FFmpegRewrap.assist(
262	                url, mayAsk: mayAsk, planned: &planned, reencodingVP9: true)
263	        else { throw remembered }
264	        guard let descriptor = probeConversion(again, of: url) else { throw failure }
265	        return descriptor
266	    }
267	
268	    /// A conversion of `url` probed, with `url` as its `original`; nil, and
269	    /// the file thrown away, when AVFoundation still will not open it. The
270	    /// conversion is cached by name, so leaving it there would hand the same
271	    /// broken result back for ever; throwing it away makes the next attempt
272	    /// a real attempt. Only the file that was probed is thrown away: one
273	    /// another import has since put at the name is left (spec §11 #227). The
274	    /// error its caller reports is the ORIGINAL one, because the file the
275	    /// user chose is the one they are being told about.
276	    private static func probeConversion(_ rewrapped: URL, of url: URL) -> MediaDescriptor? {
277	        let probed = FFmpegRewrap.fileNumber(of: rewrapped)
278	        guard var descriptor = try? waitForProbe(rewrapped) else {
279	            FFmpegRewrap.discard(rewrapped, ifStill: probed)
280	            return nil
281	        }
282	        descriptor.original = MediaOriginal(of: url)
283	        return descriptor
284	    }
285	
286	    /// The built-in copy of `source` probed, with `source` recorded as its
287	    /// `original` (spec §11 #228-O). A copy the one-frame decode
288	    /// refuses is thrown away and refused in the source's name (#216's
289	    /// backstop); any other failure throws the copy away too, so the next
290	    /// import copies again rather than reuse a movie that will not open.
291	    private static func probeCopy(_ copy: URL, of source: URL) throws -> MediaDescriptor {
292	        do {
293	            var descriptor = try waitForProbe(copy)
294	            descriptor.original = MediaOriginal(of: source)
295	            return descriptor
296	        } catch ImportError.undecodable(_, let sentence) {
297	            FFmpegRewrap.discard(copy)
298	            let copyName = copy.lastPathComponent
299	            let named = sentence.hasPrefix(copyName)
300	                ? source.lastPathComponent + sentence.dropFirst(copyName.count) : sentence
301	            throw ImportError.undecodable(source, sentence: named)
302	        } catch {
303	            FFmpegRewrap.discard(copy)
304	            throw ContainerRewrapError.failed(source, reason: "the copied movie could not be read")
305	        }
306	    }
307	
308	    /// The built-in copy of `source`, probed: the open-time re-copy of a
309	    /// copy that is gone (`ProjectDocument.recopyingMissingCopies`, spec §11
310	    /// #228-O). Never ffmpeg and never a question; `watch` as `assist`'s.
311	    static func probeBuiltInCopy(of source: URL, watch: RewrapWatch?) throws -> MediaDescriptor {
312	        try probeCopy(try ContainerRewrap.assist(source, watch: watch), of: source)
313	    }
314	
315	    /// The BLOCKING face of `probe`, for `ProjectDocument.read(from:ofType:)`.
316	    ///
317	    /// That method is synchronous by contract and CAN run on the main thread
318	    /// — NSDocumentController's open path does not always take the concurrent
319	    /// read queue (an agent's `open_project` reads on the lane's thread,
320	    /// spec §11 #231). So this must never wait on the main actor. The obvious
321	    /// spelling (a completion delivered through `MainActor.run`, joined with
322	    /// a `DispatchGroup`) deadlocks exactly there: the waiter is holding the
323	    /// one thread the completion needs, and the open dies on the timeout
324	    /// instead of the file. Here the work runs on the cooperative pool and
325	    /// the result comes back through a plain semaphore, so the waiting thread
326	    /// is never the thread being waited on. It may ask, and pass `watch`,
327	    /// unless this thread is inside `withoutAsking`.
328	    static func probeBlocking(url: URL, watch: RewrapWatch? = nil) throws -> MediaDescriptor {
329	        let quiet = isWithoutAsking
330	        return try probeAllowingRewrap(url, mayAsk: !quiet, watch: quiet ? nil : watch)
331	    }
332	
333	    /// Whether this thread is inside `withoutAsking`.
334	    static var isWithoutAsking: Bool {
335	        Thread.current.threadDictionary[withoutAskingKey] as? Bool ?? false
336	    }
337	
338	    private static let withoutAskingKey = "com.kgalligan.framejob.import.withoutAsking"
339	
340	    /// Runs `body` with `probeBlocking` on THIS thread never asking and
341	    /// never passing a watch — the scope a tool call's synchronous document
342	    /// open runs in, on the lane's thread (spec §11 MC-5, #231); the re-copy
343	    /// on open reads it too (`isWithoutAsking`). The prior value is put back
344	    /// on every exit.
345	    static func withoutAsking<T>(_ body: () throws -> T) rethrows -> T {
346	        let dictionary = Thread.current.threadDictionary
347	        let prior = dictionary[withoutAskingKey]
348	        dictionary[withoutAskingKey] = true
349	        defer { dictionary[withoutAskingKey] = prior }
350	        return try body()
351	    }
352	
353	    /// Carries one probe's outcome across the semaphore in `waitForProbe`.
354	    /// Unchecked because the join is the synchronisation: the detached task
355	    /// writes it, signals, and never touches it again; the waiter reads it
356	    /// only after the wait returns.
357	    final class ProbeBox: @unchecked Sendable {
358	        var outcome: Result<MediaDescriptor, any Error>?
359	    }
360	
361	    /// Whether the codec carries alpha. The format description's own flag
362	    /// first (ProRes 4444 and animation-with-alpha set it); the codec type is
363	    /// the fallback for files whose writer omitted the extension.
364	    static func hasAlphaChannel(_ descriptions: [CMFormatDescription]) -> Bool {
365	        for description in descriptions {
366	            if let flag = CMFormatDescriptionGetExtension(
367	                description, extensionKey: kCMFormatDescriptionExtension_ContainsAlphaChannel)
368	                as? Bool, flag {
369	                return true
370	            }
371	            switch CMFormatDescriptionGetMediaSubType(description) {
372	            // 'ap4h' ProRes 4444, 'ap4x' ProRes 4444 XQ, 'rle ' animation.
373	            case 0x6170_3468, 0x6170_3478, 0x726C_6520:
374	                return true
375	            default:
376	                continue
377	            }
378	        }
379	        return false
380	    }
381	}

1	import AVFoundation
2	import CoreMedia
3	import VideoToolbox

5	/// A WebM or Matroska file opened by a built-in rewrap (spec §11 #216-R):
6	/// the core indexes the container (`ReelContainer`) and its first video and
7	/// audio streams are copied, unchanged, into a QuickTime movie under
8	/// `~/Library/Application Support/Frame Job/Rewrapped/`, the folder ffmpeg's
9	/// conversions use, by `FFmpegRewrap.destination(for:)`'s digest name — so a
10	/// second import of the same file reuses the copy.
11	///
12	/// The order is the decision's: the core opens the file; a codec this Mac
13	/// cannot decode is refused in #216's sentence BEFORE anything is copied
14	/// (VP8, AV1 without hardware decode, VP9 Profile 1 or 3), and a codec the
15	/// copy cannot carry is refused in its own (`unsupported`), which alone
16	/// falls through to the opt-in ffmpeg step; the video is snapped to its
17	/// frame grid when it lies on one; the copy's size is checked against the
18	/// free space first; and the movie is written under a `.partial.mov` name
19	/// and moved into place, so a failure leaves no file behind.
20	///
21	/// Await-free (spec §11 W-8): `ContainerRewrapWriter` waits on its writer
22	/// through a semaphore.
23	enum ContainerRewrap {
24	
25	    /// Whether `url` begins with an EBML header: 1A 45 DF A3.
26	    static func isMatroska(_ url: URL) -> Bool {
27	        guard let handle = try? FileHandle(forReadingFrom: url) else { return false }
28	        defer { try? handle.close() }
29	        let head = (try? handle.read(upToCount: 4)) ?? Data()
30	        return head == Data([0x1A, 0x45, 0xDF, 0xA3])
31	    }
32	
33	    /// Held across the existence re-check and the copy, so two imports of one
34	    /// file copy it once. Never held across a wait on the main thread (a
35	    /// watch only posts to main, and a tool call passes none), so it cannot
36	    /// deadlock against the agent lane's lock (spec §11 #231).
37	    private static let lock = NSLock()
38	
39	    /// The movie for `source`: a copy already on disk, else a new one.
40	    /// `watch` is called once, on this thread, when a new copy starts, with
41	    /// the progress the copy reports to and reads its Cancel from (spec §11
42	    /// #228-P); a reused copy calls none, and a tool call passes none.
43	    static func assist(_ source: URL, watch: RewrapWatch? = nil) throws -> URL {
44	        if let existing = FFmpegRewrap.existingRewrap(of: source) { return existing }
45	        guard let destination = FFmpegRewrap.destination(for: source) else {
46	            throw ContainerRewrapError.failed(source, reason: "the copy folder could not be found")
47	        }
48	        lock.lock()
49	        defer { lock.unlock() }
50	        if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: destination.path) { return destination }
51	        let progress = RewrapProgress(source: source)
52	        watch?(progress)
53	        defer { progress.finish() }
54	        try rewrap(source, to: destination, progress: progress)
55	        return destination
56	    }
57	
58	    /// Copies `source` into a movie at `destination`. `freeBytes` stands in
59	    /// for the volume's free space, `stopAfter` fails the copy after that
60	    /// many samples and `refuseAudioAt` has the writer refuse that audio
61	    /// sample — the three seams the probe drives; the app passes none.
62	    /// `progress` is told the copy's size and each sample's bytes, and its
63	    /// Cancel is read after the index opens, before the write and between
64	    /// samples; a cancelled copy throws `.cancelled` with nothing left.
65	    static func rewrap(
66	        _ source: URL, to destination: URL, freeBytes: Int64? = nil, stopAfter: Int? = nil,
67	        refuseAudioAt: Int? = nil, progress: RewrapProgress? = nil
68	    ) throws {
69	        let container: ReelContainer
70	        do {
71	            container = try ReelContainer(path: source.path)
72	        } catch {
73	            let reason = (error as? ReelCoreError)?.message ?? error.localizedDescription
74	            throw ContainerRewrapError.unreadable(source, reason: reason)
75	        }
76	        if progress?.isCancelled == true { throw ContainerRewrapError.cancelled(source) }
77	        var description = try describe(container, source)
78	        if description.video == nil, description.audio == nil {
79	            throw MediaImporter.ImportError.noTracks(source)
80	        }
81	        try precheck(description, source)
82	        if let nominal = description.video?.nominalFps {
83	            _ = container.retime(MediaImporter.rationalFrameRate(nominal))
84	            description = try describe(container, source)
85	        }
86	        try checkSpace(for: description, source, at: destination, freeBytes: freeBytes)
87	        if progress?.isCancelled == true { throw ContainerRewrapError.cancelled(source) }
88	        do {
89	            try AppSupport.ensureDirectory(destination.deletingLastPathComponent())
90	        } catch {
91	            throw ContainerRewrapError.failed(source, reason: "the copy folder could not be created")
92	        }
93	        let manager = FileManager.default
94	        let partial = destination.deletingPathExtension().appendingPathExtension("partial.mov")
95	        try? manager.removeItem(at: partial)
96	        progress?.begin(
97	            totalBytes: (description.video?.bytes ?? 0) + (description.audio?.bytes ?? 0))
98	        do {
99	            try ContainerRewrapWriter.write(
100	                container, description, from: source, to: partial, stopAfter: stopAfter,
101	                refuseAudioAt: refuseAudioAt, progress: progress)
102	            try manager.moveItem(at: partial, to: destination)
103	        } catch {
104	            try? manager.removeItem(at: partial)
105	            if error is ContainerRewrapError { throw error }
106	            throw ContainerRewrapError.failed(source, reason: error.localizedDescription)
107	        }
108	    }
109	
110	    private static func describe(
111	        _ container: ReelContainer, _ source: URL
112	    ) throws -> ContainerDescription {
113	        let decoder = JSONDecoder()
114	        decoder.keyDecodingStrategy = .convertFromSnakeCase
115	        guard let description = try? decoder.decode(
116	            ContainerDescription.self, from: Data(container.describeJSON.utf8))
117	        else {
118	            throw ContainerRewrapError.unreadable(source, reason: "its index could not be read")
119	        }
120	        return description
121	    }
122	
123	    // MARK: - Before the copy
124	
125	    /// #216's refusals from the codec facts in the Tracks element, then a
126	    /// codec the copy does not carry.
127	    private static func precheck(_ d: ContainerDescription, _ source: URL) throws {
128	        let fileName = source.lastPathComponent
129	        if let video = d.video, !video.encoded, let fourcc = video.fourcc {
130	            let codec = fourCharCode(fourcc)
131	            let av1Hardware = VTIsHardwareDecodeSupported(kCMVideoCodecType_AV1)
132	            let profile = video.vp9Profile
133	            let undecodable = fourcc == "vp08"
134	                || (codec == kCMVideoCodecType_AV1 && !av1Hardware)
135	                || (codec == kCMVideoCodecType_VP9 && (profile == 1 || profile == 3))
136	            if undecodable {
137	                throw MediaImporter.ImportError.undecodable(
138	                    source,
139	                    sentence: DecoderSupport.refusal(
140	                        fileName: fileName, codec: codec, vp9Profile: profile,
141	                        av1Hardware: av1Hardware))
142	            }
143	        }
144	        let tracks: [(kind: String, codecID: String, fourcc: String?, encoded: Bool)] = [
145	            d.video.map { ("video", $0.codecId, $0.fourcc, $0.encoded) },
146	            d.audio.map { ("audio", $0.codecId, $0.fourcc, $0.encoded) },
147	        ].compactMap { $0 }
148	        for track in tracks where track.fourcc == nil || track.encoded {
149	            throw ContainerRewrapError.unsupported(
150	                source,
151	                sentence: unsupported(
152	                    fileName: fileName, kind: track.kind, codecID: track.codecID,
153	                    encoded: track.encoded))
154	        }
155	    }
156	
157	    /// The free space on the volume the copy goes to, against what the core
158	    /// says the copy needs. With no reading of the volume, the copy goes on.
159	    private static func checkSpace(
160	        for d: ContainerDescription, _ source: URL, at destination: URL, freeBytes: Int64?
161	    ) throws {
162	        var folder = destination.deletingLastPathComponent()
163	        while !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: folder.path), folder.path != "/" {
164	            folder = folder.deletingLastPathComponent()
165	        }
166	        let values = try? folder.resourceValues(forKeys: [
167	            .volumeAvailableCapacityForImportantUsageKey, .volumeLocalizedNameKey, .volumeNameKey,
168	        ])
169	        guard let free = freeBytes ?? values?.volumeAvailableCapacityForImportantUsage else {
170	            return
171	        }
172	        let needed = Int64(clamping: d.requiredBytes)
173	        guard free < needed else { return }
174	        let volume = values?.volumeLocalizedName ?? values?.volumeName ?? "the disk"
175	        throw ContainerRewrapError.noSpace(
176	            source,
177	            sentence: spaceRefusal(
178	                fileName: source.lastPathComponent, needed: needed, free: free, volume: volume))
179	    }
180	
181	    // MARK: - The sentences
182	
183	    /// The names a refusal gives a codec it does not copy.
184	    private static let codecNames: [String: String] = [
185	        "A_VORBIS": "Vorbis", "A_FLAC": "FLAC", "A_MPEG/L3": "MP3", "A_MPEG/L2": "MP2",
186	        "A_AC3": "AC-3", "A_EAC3": "E-AC-3", "A_DTS": "DTS", "A_TRUEHD": "TrueHD",
187	        "V_MPEG2": "MPEG-2", "V_MPEG4/ISO/ASP": "MPEG-4 Part 2", "V_THEORA": "Theora",
188	        "V_PRORES": "ProRes",
189	    ]
190	
191	    static func unsupported(fileName: String, kind: String, codecID: String, encoded: Bool)
192	        -> String
193	    {
194	        let tail = "which Frame Job cannot copy out of a WebM or Matroska file."
195	        if encoded {
196	            return "\(fileName) has a compressed or encrypted \(kind) track, \(tail)"
197	        }
198	        let name = codecNames[codecID]
199	            ?? (codecID.hasPrefix("A_PCM/") ? "PCM" : "“\(codecID)”")
200	        return "\(fileName) has \(name) \(kind), \(tail)"
201	    }
202	
203	    static func spaceRefusal(fileName: String, needed: Int64, free: Int64, volume: String)
204	        -> String
205	    {
206	        let need = ByteCountFormatter.string(fromByteCount: needed, countStyle: .file)
207	        let left = ByteCountFormatter.string(fromByteCount: free, countStyle: .file)
208	        return "Not enough free space to open \(fileName): its video and sound need about"
209	            + " \(need) on “\(volume)”, which has \(left) free. Nothing was copied."
210	    }
211	
212	    /// A four-character code from its four ASCII letters.
213	    static func fourCharCode(_ text: String) -> FourCharCode {
214	        text.utf8.prefix(4).reduce(0) { ($0 << 8) | FourCharCode($1) }
215	    }
216	}
217	
218	/// Why a WebM or Matroska file was not copied. Only `unsupported` invites
219	/// the opt-in ffmpeg step: the copy cannot carry that codec and ffmpeg may.
220	enum ContainerRewrapError: LocalizedError {
221	    case unsupported(URL, sentence: String)
222	    case noSpace(URL, sentence: String)
223	    case unreadable(URL, reason: String)
224	    case failed(URL, reason: String)
225	    /// The person's Cancel (spec §11 #228-P); never presented.
226	    case cancelled(URL)
227	
228	    var errorDescription: String? {
229	        switch self {
230	        case .unsupported(_, let sentence), .noSpace(_, let sentence):
231	            return sentence
232	        case .unreadable(let url, let reason):
233	            return "Could not read \(url.lastPathComponent): \(reason)."
234	        case .failed(let url, let reason):
235	            return "Could not copy \(url.lastPathComponent) into a movie: \(reason)."
236	        case .cancelled(let url):
237	            return "Copying \(url.lastPathComponent) was cancelled."
238	        }
239	    }
240	
241	    var invitesFFmpeg: Bool {
242	        if case .unsupported = self { return true }
243	        return false
244	    }
245	}
246	
247	/// `rc_container_describe`'s JSON (the header's keys, read snake_case).
248	struct ContainerDescription: Decodable {
249	    struct Video: Decodable {
250	        let codecId: String
251	        let fourcc: String?
252	        let encoded: Bool
253	        let width: Int
254	        let height: Int
255	        let atom: String?
256	        let atomHex: String?
257	        let vp9Profile: Int?
258	        let nominalFps: Double?
259	        let timescale: Int64
260	        let grid: Bool
261	        let samples: Int
262	        let bytes: UInt64
263	        /// The Colour element's HDR10 fields as HD-12's two blobs, and its
264	        /// codes (spec §11 HD-18 (a)); nil when the file has none.
265	        let mdcvHex: String?
266	        let clliHex: String?
267	        let transfer: Int?
268	        let primaries: Int?
269	        let matrix: Int?
270	        /// A VP9 track's first keyframe's matrix code (1, 6 or 9), the SDR label's fallback
271	        /// when the Colour names none (spec §11 CX-16 (10)); nil otherwise.
272	        let streamMatrix: Int?
273	    }
274	
275	    struct Audio: Decodable {
276	        let codecId: String
277	        let fourcc: String?
278	        let encoded: Bool
279	        let sampleRate: Double
280	        let channels: Int
281	        let cookieHex: String
282	        let framesPerPacket: Int
283	        let timescale: Int64
284	        let samples: Int
285	        let bytes: UInt64
286	    }
287	
288	    let docType: String
289	    let requiredBytes: UInt64
290	    let video: Video?
291	    let audio: Audio?
292	}

# app/CLAUDE.md — Swift app rules

Applies to everything under `app/`. Build/verification commands and the FFI
lockstep are in the root `CLAUDE.md`; the full design is
`designs/spec/` (§3–4 the UI, §7.4–7.8 the platform side; its `README.md` is
the index). The
long form of each entry below — why each file is the shape it is, and the
traps its history turned up — is `designs/adr/app-file-history.md` (the
full history, every size toll and measurement, is archived; see its
"Original" line); this file is what governs a file now. Files
are listed by family; a file with a header comment of its own carries its
detail there.

## File map

**The core's edge.**
- `ReelCore.swift` — with its `ReelCore+<Area>.swift` files, the only files
  that call `rc_*` (spec §11 CJ-8 (l)); a new wrapper goes in the file of its
  area. `ReelCore.swift` holds `ReelProject`
  (handle + lazily decoded `ProjectSnapshot`; `json`, `snapshot` and
  `planJSON` are memoised PER HANDLE, so keep handles rather than minting
  them; so is `sourceMap(_:)`, `rc_project_source_map` decoded and checked
  once per handle and clip, SR-20), timecode, snapping (export presets/sizes/settings are
  `ExportValues.swift`'s, a pure move, HDR H-1), `ReelSpeed.limits` (the
  core's speed range and audio ceiling, typed as `SpeedLimits` in
  `CoreValues.swift` — no Swift file types a speed bound), `ReelColor` (`rc_normalise_color`, G-25) and `ReelAgentSocket` (below);
  `ReelCore+MediaFiles.swift` holds the media files the core reads or writes —
  `ReelContainer` (`rc_container_*`, a WebM/Matroska file's index, #216-R), `ReelCube`,
  `ReelHDR10` (`rc_hdr10_peak`, spec §11 HD-6; `av1Peak`, `rc_hdr10_av1_peak`, HD-18;
  `stillPeak`, `rc_hdr10_still_peak`, HD-20), `ReelAV1` and `ReelWebM` (`rc_webm_*`, the
  `av1_webm` writer, spec §11 CX-15) — `ReelCore+Cursor.swift` holds `ReelCursor`
  (`rc_cursor_open`, `rc_cursor_free`: a cursor file's open, which is its check, spec
  §11 CU-9, CU-15; road map creator-jobs CU1a; and `query`, `rc_cursor_query`'s one
  JSON request, CU2, spec §11 CU-25, and the static `query(_:tracks:project:)`, the
  same call over n tracks with a project (`plan_zooms`, CU-70)) — `ReelCore+Framing.swift`
  holds `SpeakerMatch` and `ReelProject.speakerMatch` (`rc_project_speaker_match`, road map
  creator-jobs VR6b, spec §11 VR-65: the face-to-microphone match Make Vertical's sheet
  confirms) — and `ReelCore+Graphics.swift` the graphics engine's

**Frozen files.** `EditorViewController.swift`, `TimelineView.swift`,
`PreviewCanvasView.swift`, `AgentServer.swift` are **frozen at current
size**: anything adding more than ~50 lines goes in an extension file
(`EditorViewController+<Feature>.swift`, `TimelineView+<Feature>.swift`,
`AgentServer+<Feature>.swift`) or a new `…SheetController`, and the frozen
file keeps only the wiring — a stored property, a closure assignment, a
validator arm, a draw call. The pieces extension files build on are therefore
internal, not private. Pitfalls: a selector declared `@objc` on an extension
needs NO forward in the frozen file (a second declaration is an error); a
command whose body sits at the foot of a non-extension feature file carries
its validator arm there too, or the item falls through to the closing
`return true`; `handleEditorCharacter`'s bare-key `switch` matches in SOURCE
order, so a bare `case "x"` goes BELOW any modified `case "x" where …`; and
`handleEditorKey` refuses while a sheet is attached, because a sheet is
window-modal and the preview panel's forwarded keys would otherwise reach
the key map behind it.

1	// app/Sources/ProjectDocument+Import.swift — File > Add Media… and every drop
     2	// into an open project, and the Media tab's and the missing-media sheet's
     3	// relinks: the probe chain and the one grouped commit, for both.
     4	//
     5	// A pure move out of `ProjectDocument.swift` (road map 10, G3a), which is
     6	// over the ~600-line cap and gave this up before taking the `graphics/`
     7	// store's lines. `present(_:)`, internal so this file can reach it, lives in
     8	// `+Alerts`.
     9	
    10	import AppKit
    11	
    12	extension ProjectDocument {
    13	    // MARK: - Media import
    14	
    15	    /// File > Add Media… and every drop that adds files to an OPEN project.
    16	    /// Probing is asynchronous, so the files are probed one at a time and the
    17	    /// whole batch commits as ONE undo step; `completion` gets the new media
    18	    /// ids in the order the files were given, on the main thread.
    19	    func importMedia(_ urls: [URL], completion: (([UInt32]) -> Void)? = nil) {
    20	        guard !urls.isEmpty else {
    21	            completion?([])
    22	            return
    23	        }
    24	        probeNext(urls, index: 0, descriptors: [], completion: completion)
    25	    }
    26	
    27	    private func probeNext(
    28	        _ urls: [URL], index: Int, descriptors: [MediaDescriptor],
    29	        completion: (([UInt32]) -> Void)?
    30	    ) {
    31	        guard index < urls.count else {
    32	            // Two statements, never `completion?(commitImport(descriptors))`:
    33	            // optional chaining skips the ARGUMENT too, so with no completion
    34	            // — File ▸ Add Media… and a Media-tab drop pass none — the files
    35	            // were probed and never added, with no beep and no error.
    36	            let added = commitImport(descriptors)
    37	            completion?(added)
    38	            return
    39	        }
    40	        MediaImporter.probe(url: urls[index], mayAsk: true, watch: Self.copyWatch) {
    41	            [weak self] result in
    42	            guard let self = self else { return }
    43	            var collected = descriptors
    44	            switch result {
    45	            case .success(let descriptor):
    46	                collected.append(descriptor)
    47	            case .failure(let error) where Self.isCancelledCopy(error):
    48	                break  // the person's Cancel: the file is left out, unannounced
    49	            case .failure(let error):
    50	                // One unreadable file must not lose the rest of the drop.
    51	                self.present(error)
    52	            }
    53	            self.probeNext(
    54	                urls, index: index + 1, descriptors: collected, completion: completion)
    55	        }
    56	    }
    57	
    58	    private func commitImport(_ descriptors: [MediaDescriptor]) -> [UInt32] {
    59	        guard !descriptors.isEmpty else { return [] }
    60	        let before = Set(project.snapshot.media.map { $0.id })
    61	        performGroupedEdit(
    62	            descriptors.count == 1 ? "Add Media" : "Add \(descriptors.count) Media Files",
    63	            descriptors.map { ReelOp.addMedia(descriptor: $0) })
    64	        let added = project.snapshot.media.filter { !before.contains($0.id) }
    65	        generateCaches()
    66	        return added.map { $0.id }
    67	    }
    68	
    69	    // MARK: - Relink (spec §11, #63)
    70	
    71	    /// The Media tab's Relink… and the missing-media sheet's Relink: each
    72	    /// chosen file is probed in order through import's own
    73	    /// `MediaImporter.probe` (ffmpeg's opt-in step included), an unreadable
    74	    /// one is presented and skipped, and every probed relink commits as ONE
    75	    /// undo step, then the cache pass. The path and bookmark are the
    76	    /// descriptor's — the rewrapped `.mov` when ffmpeg converted — and the
    77	    /// core takes the file's duration, size, rate and flags from its probe,
    78	    /// refuses a file of another kind in its own sentence, and holds a clip
    79	    /// that runs past a shorter file's end to it.
    80	    ///
    81	    /// `alertingRefusals` is the sheet's (#180): #88's fold answers a list
    82	    /// that applied with no refusal, so the ops are tried first on the
    83	    /// project as it stands, and after the commit and the cache pass each
    84	    /// refused sentence is presented, verbatim and in order. The Media tab
    85	    /// passes one op and keeps the default: the fold's beep and CI-10 strip.
    86	    /// On both doors an unreadable file is presented at once; `present(_:)`
    87	    /// shows each alert in turn.
    88	    func relinkMedia(_ choices: [(media: UInt32, url: URL)], alertingRefusals: Bool = false) {
    89	        relinkNext(choices, index: 0, ops: [], alertingRefusals: alertingRefusals)
    90	    }

    92	    private func relinkNext(
    93	        _ choices: [(media: UInt32, url: URL)], index: Int, ops: [ReelOp],
    94	        alertingRefusals: Bool
    95	    ) {
    96	        guard index < choices.count else {
    97	            guard !ops.isEmpty else { return }
    98	            let refusals = alertingRefusals ? relinkRefusals(ops) : []
    99	            // The probe's completion is not an AppKit event: the grouped
   100	            // entry point is mandatory (app/CLAUDE.md's undo pitfall).
   101	            performGroupedEdit("Relink Media", ops)
   102	            generateCaches()
   103	            for refusal in refusals { present(RelinkRefusalAlert(refusal: refusal)) }
   104	            return
   105	        }
   106	        let choice = choices[index]
   107	        MediaImporter.probe(url: choice.url, mayAsk: true, watch: Self.copyWatch) {
   108	            [weak self] result in
   109	            guard let self = self else { return }

   134	    private func relinkRefusals(_ ops: [ReelOp]) -> [ReelRefusal] {

   140	            case .applied(let next): current = next
   141	            case .identity: break
   142	            case .refused(let refusal): refusals.append(refusal)
   143	            }
   144	        }
   145	        return refusals

   149	    struct RelinkRefusalAlert: LocalizedError {
   150	        let refusal: ReelRefusal

   159	    static var copyWatch: RewrapWatch = RewrapProgressWindowController.watch

   162	    /// drop on the Dock or a window read on NSDocumentController's

   164	    /// thread no watch is passed; an agent's `open_project` reads off main

   168	    static func probeForOpening(

   181	    static func isCancelledCopy(_ error: any Error) -> Bool {
   182	        if case ContainerRewrapError.cancelled = error { return true }

     3	/// The open-time repairs of a project's media, after `project.json` is read
     4	/// and before the document is shown: the re-anchor of consolidated media
     5	/// (`ProjectDocument.reanchoringConsolidatedMedia`) and, here, the re-copy
     6	/// of a WebM or Matroska copy that is gone (spec §11 #228-O, O13 and Q3).
     7	///
     8	/// Neither is an edit. Both run where `readPackage` runs — on
     9	/// NSDocumentController's read queue for a person's File ▸ Open, on the
    10	/// lane's thread inside `withoutAsking` for an agent's `open_project` (spec
    11	/// §11 #231), on the main thread for a read AppKit runs there — before the
    12	/// document exists as far as AppKit is concerned, so they register no undo
    13	/// step, dirty nothing and show no alert; whatever save comes next writes
    14	/// the new paths out.
    15	extension ProjectDocument {
    16	
    17	    /// `readPackage`'s repairs, in order: the re-anchor first, so a
    18	    /// consolidated copy found in the package's `media/` is never copied
    19	    /// again, then the cursor files' re-anchor (spec §11 CU-52), then the
    20	    /// re-copy.
    21	    static func repairingMedia(_ project: ReelProject, package: URL) -> ReelProject {
    22	        let anchored = reanchoringConsolidatedMedia(project, package: package)
    23	        let cursors = reanchoringCursorFiles(anchored, package: package)
    24	        return recopyingMissingCopies(cursors)
    25	    }
    26	
    27	    /// Points each media's cursor file at the package's `media/` when it was
    28	    /// consolidated there and the package has moved (road map creator-jobs
    29	    /// CU5, spec §11 CU-52): a `media.cursor` whose `cursorURL(for:)` names no
    30	    /// file, while `<package>/media/<its path's last component>` exists, gets
    31	    /// `set_media_cursor {path: that file, in_picture}` — no bookmark, as
    32	    /// Consolidate writes it. Applied purely, as the media re-anchor is.
    33	    static func reanchoringCursorFiles(_ project: ReelProject, package: URL) -> ReelProject {
    34	        // `media/`, `ProjectDocument`'s private `mediaDirectoryName`, which this
    35	        // extension in another file cannot read (`ProjectDocument.swift` takes
    36	        // no line for CU5).
    37	        let directory = package.appendingPathComponent("media", isDirectory: true)
    38	        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: directory.path) else { return project }
    39	        var ops: [ReelOp] = []
    40	        for media in project.snapshot.media {
    41	            guard let cursor = media.cursor, let file = cursorURL(for: media),
    42	                !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: file.path)
    43	            else { continue }
    44	            let name = (cursor.path as NSString).lastPathComponent
    45	            guard !name.isEmpty else { continue }
    46	            let candidate = directory.appendingPathComponent(name)
    47	            guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: candidate.path) else { continue }
    48	            ops.append(
    49	                .setMediaCursor(
    50	                    media: media.id,
    51	                    cursor: MediaCursor(path: candidate.path, inPicture: cursor.inPicture)))
    52	        }
    53	        guard !ops.isEmpty else { return project }
    54	        // Only `.applied` is a repair; both other arms leave it as opened.
    55	        return (try? project.applying(ops)).project ?? project
    56	    }

    58	    /// Copies again every WebM or Matroska copy that is gone, from its
    59	    /// original, and points the media at the new copy with its probe.
    60	    ///
    61	    /// A media is copied again when all four hold: its copy is gone —
    62	    /// `mediaURL(for:)` resolves nothing, or resolves inside the Trash
    63	    /// (`trashed`), where Finder's delete moves the copy and its bookmark
    64	    /// follows it; it has an `original`; the original resolves; and the
    65	    /// original is still a Matroska file. The copy is the built-in one only
    66	    /// (`MediaImporter.probeBuiltInCopy`): never ffmpeg, never a question.
    67	    /// The Trash counts as gone HERE only; every other reader of
    68	    /// `mediaURL(for:)` still plays a copy from the Trash.
    69	    ///
    70	    /// Each copy shows #228-P's window after 1 s through `watch`, except on
    71	    /// the main thread, where a window could not be shown, and inside
    72	    /// `withoutAsking`, an agent's `open_project` (MC-5, #231): no watch is
    73	    /// passed there. Copies run one at a time (`ContainerRewrap.assist`'s
    74	    /// lock). A Cancel or any failure skips that media (Q3): a missing copy
    75	    /// stays missing, with the slate, the badge and Relink…, and the next
    76	    /// open tries again; a copy in the Trash keeps its path and bookmark.
    77	    ///
    78	    /// `trashed` is the probe's seam, so the Trash case is proved without
    79	    /// touching the real Trash; the app passes none.
    80	    static func recopyingMissingCopies(
    81	        _ project: ReelProject, watch: RewrapWatch? = RewrapProgressWindowController.watch,
    82	        trashed: (URL) -> Bool = isTrashed
    83	    ) -> ReelProject {
    84	        let shown = Thread.isMainThread || MediaImporter.isWithoutAsking ? nil : watch
    85	        var ops: [ReelOp] = []
    86	        for media in project.snapshot.media where media.original != nil {
    87	            let copy = mediaURL(for: media)
    88	            guard copy == nil || copy.map(trashed) == true else { continue }
    89	            guard let source = originalURL(for: media), ContainerRewrap.isMatroska(source) else {
    90	                continue
    91	            }
    92	            guard let copied = try? MediaImporter.probeBuiltInCopy(of: source, watch: shown)
    93	            else { continue }
    94	            let descriptor = MediaImporter.relinkProbe(copied, current: media)  // CU-38 (a)
    95	            ops.append(
    96	                .relinkMedia(
    97	                    media: media.id, path: descriptor.path, bookmark: descriptor.bookmark,
    98	                    probe: descriptor))
    99	        }
   100	        guard !ops.isEmpty else { return project }
   101	        // Only `.applied` is a repair; both other arms leave it as opened.
   102	        return (try? project.applying(ops)).project ?? project
   103	    }
   104	}

     3	/// One WebM or Matroska copy's progress and its Cancel (spec §11 #228-P):
     4	/// the copying thread reports bytes, the window polls them on main, and a
     5	/// Cancel from main is read by the copy between samples. All state is
     6	/// behind one lock, so any thread may call any member (hence the
     7	/// unchecked `Sendable`). Await-free, no AppKit.
     8	final class RewrapProgress: @unchecked Sendable {
     9	    let source: URL
    10	
    11	    private let lock = NSLock()
    12	    private var cancelled = false
    13	    private var finished = false
    14	    private var total: UInt64 = 0
    15	    private var copied: UInt64 = 0
    16	    private var begun = false
    17	    private var lateAdds = 0
    18	    private var cancelFraction: Double?
    19	
    20	    init(source: URL) {
    21	        self.source = source
    22	    }
    23	
    24	    var isCancelled: Bool { locked { cancelled } }
    25	    var isFinished: Bool { locked { finished } }
    26	    /// 0 until `begin`.
    27	    var totalBytes: UInt64 { locked { total } }
    28	    var copiedBytes: UInt64 { locked { copied } }
    29	
    30	    /// nil until `begin`; then copied over total, clamped to 0…1 (1 for an
    31	    /// empty total).
    32	    var fraction: Double? {
    33	        locked {
    34	            guard begun else { return nil }
    35	            guard total > 0 else { return 1 }
    36	            return min(max(Double(copied) / Double(total), 0), 1)
    37	        }
    38	    }
    39	
    40	    /// The probe's seam: `add(bytes:)` cancels once the fraction reaches
    41	    /// it. The app sets none.
    42	    var cancelAt: Double? {
    43	        get { locked { cancelFraction } }
    44	        set { locked { cancelFraction = newValue } }
    45	    }
    46	
    47	    /// `add(bytes:)` calls made while already cancelled; the call that trips
    48	    /// `cancelAt` is not one of them.
    49	    var addsAfterCancel: Int { locked { lateAdds } }
    50	
    51	    func cancel() { locked { cancelled = true } }
    52	
    53	    /// The copy's size: the described video and audio bytes, just before
    54	    /// the write begins.
    55	    func begin(totalBytes: UInt64) {
    56	        locked {
    57	            total = totalBytes
    58	            copied = 0
    59	            begun = true
    60	        }
    61	    }
    62	
    63	    /// One appended sample's bytes.
    64	    func add(bytes: UInt64) {
    65	        locked {
    66	            if cancelled { lateAdds += 1 }
    67	            copied &+= bytes
    68	            if let at = cancelFraction, begun, !cancelled {
    69	                let reached = total == 0 ? 1 : Double(copied) / Double(total)
    70	                if reached >= at { cancelled = true }
    71	            }
    72	        }
    73	    }
    74	
    75	    /// The copy has ended, however it ended; the window closes on it.
    76	    func finish() { locked { finished = true } }
    77	
    78	    private func locked<T>(_ body: () -> T) -> T {
    79	        lock.lock()
    80	        defer { lock.unlock() }
    81	        return body()
    82	    }
    83	}

    86	/// for a copy already on disk. The click doors pass
    87	/// `RewrapProgressWindowController.watch`; a tool call passes none.
    88	typealias RewrapWatch = (RewrapProgress) -> Void

     3	/// The WebM or Matroska copy's progress window (spec §11 #228-P): a small
     4	/// titled panel, the same for every click door, with the bar, the file's
     5	/// name, how much is copied and one Cancel. It is non-modal and never takes
     6	/// the keyboard from a Frame Job window: it shows only when the copy is still
     7	/// running `showDelay` after it started, ordered front without becoming key
     8	/// while any window is key (made key only when none is — File ▸ Open, a
     9	/// Finder double-click), so typing and Escape keep reaching the editor
    10	/// until the person clicks into it.
    11	///
    12	/// `watch` is the `RewrapWatch` the click doors pass: called on the copying
    13	/// thread, it hops to main, keeps a controller in `live` and polls the
    14	/// progress on a run-loop timer, as `Exporter.startProgressTimer` does,
    15	/// until the copy finishes; then the window closes and the controller goes.
    16	/// It raises no modal, no sheet and no alert. Copies are serial
    17	/// (`ContainerRewrap.assist`'s lock), so at most one is live.
    18	final class RewrapProgressWindowController: NSWindowController {
    19	    static let showDelay: TimeInterval = 1.0
    20	    static let pollInterval: TimeInterval = 0.1
    21	
    22	    /// Main-only: one controller per copy not yet finished.
    23	    static private(set) var live: [RewrapProgressWindowController] = []
    24	
    25	    let progress: RewrapProgress
    26	    /// Built in `loadView`; the button's action and its Escape key
    27	    /// equivalent are `cancelCopy(_:)`.
    28	    private(set) var cancelButton: StickerButton!
    29	
    30	    private let bar = NSProgressIndicator()
    31	    private let detailLabel = NSTextField(labelWithString: "")
    32	    private var timer: Timer?
    33	    private let started = Date()
    34	
    35	    init(progress: RewrapProgress) {
    36	        self.progress = progress
    37	        let panel = NSPanel(
    38	            contentRect: NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: sheetWidth, height: 160),
    39	            styleMask: [.titled], backing: .buffered, defer: true)
    40	        panel.title = "Copying Movie"
    41	        panel.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
    42	        panel.isRestorable = false
    43	        panel.hidesOnDeactivate = false
    44	        panel.becomesKeyOnlyIfNeeded = false
    45	        super.init(window: panel)
    46	        loadView()
    47	    }
    48	
    49	    @available(*, unavailable)
    50	    required init?(coder: NSCoder) {
    51	        fatalError("RewrapProgressWindowController does not support NSCoder")
    52	    }
    53	
    54	    private func loadView() {
    55	        styleSheetProgressBar(bar, indeterminate: true)
    56	
    57	        styleSheetDetailLabel(detailLabel)
    58	        detailLabel.stringValue = Self.detail(for: progress)
    59	
    60	        let content = makeProgressStack([bar, detailLabel])
    61	
    62	        cancelButton = StickerButton(
    63	            title: "Cancel", style: .secondary, target: self, action: #selector(cancelCopy(_:)))
    64	        let apply = StickerButton(title: "Close", style: .primary, target: nil, action: nil)
    65	        hideReturnTarget(apply)
    66	
    67	        let view = makeSheetView(
    68	            title: "Copying “\(progress.source.lastPathComponent)”",
    69	            hint: "Frame Job copies the video and sound of a WebM or MKV file into a movie once, "
    70	                + "without re-encoding. Importing the same file again uses the copy.",
    71	            content: content, buttonRow: makeButtonRow(cancel: cancelButton, apply: apply))
    72	        window?.contentView = view
    73	        view.layoutSubtreeIfNeeded()
    74	        window?.setContentSize(view.fittingSize)
    75	    }
    76	
    77	    /// Cancel, and Escape once the panel is key: the copy stops before its
    78	    /// next sample and its partial file is deleted (`ContainerRewrap`).
    79	    @objc func cancelCopy(_ sender: Any?) {
    80	        progress.cancel()
    81	        cancelButton.title = "Cancelling…"
    82	        cancelButton.isEnabled = false
    83	    }
    84	
    85	    /// A `RewrapWatch`: any thread; hops to main for the window.
    86	    nonisolated static func watch(_ progress: RewrapProgress) {
    87	        if Thread.isMainThread {
    88	            MainActor.assumeIsolated { start(progress) }
    89	        } else {
    90	            DispatchQueue.main.async { MainActor.assumeIsolated { start(progress) } }
    91	        }
    92	    }
    93	
    94	    private static func start(_ progress: RewrapProgress) {
    95	        let controller = RewrapProgressWindowController(progress: progress)
    96	        live.append(controller)
    97	        // `.common` modes: the panel keeps polling during menu tracking and
    98	        // behind a modal alert.
    99	        let timer = Timer(timeInterval: pollInterval, repeats: true) { [weak controller] _ in
   100	            MainActor.assumeIsolated { controller?.poll() }
   101	        }
   102	        RunLoop.main.add(timer, forMode: .common)
   103	        controller.timer = timer
   104	    }
   105	
   106	    /// "Reading the file…" until the copy has begun, then "412 MB of 1.2 GB".
   107	    nonisolated static func detail(for progress: RewrapProgress) -> String {
   108	        guard progress.fraction != nil else { return "Reading the file…" }
   109	        let copied = ByteCountFormatter.string(
   110	            fromByteCount: Int64(clamping: progress.copiedBytes), countStyle: .file)
   111	        let total = ByteCountFormatter.string(
   112	            fromByteCount: Int64(clamping: progress.totalBytes), countStyle: .file)
   113	        return "\(copied) of \(total)"
   114	    }
   115	
   116	    private func poll() {
   117	        guard !progress.isFinished else {
   118	            timer?.invalidate()
   119	            timer = nil
   120	            close()
   121	            Self.live.removeAll { $0 === self }
   122	            return
   123	        }
   124	        if let window, !window.isVisible, Date().timeIntervalSince(started) >= Self.showDelay {
   125	            window.center()
   126	            // Never take the keyboard from a Frame Job window (spec §11
   127	            // #228-P): a click into the panel makes it key. An inactive app
   128	            // has no key window, so it gets the panel ordered front, not key.
   129	            if NSApp.isActive && NSApp.keyWindow == nil {
   130	                window.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
   131	            } else {
   132	                window.orderFront(nil)
   133	            }
   134	        }
   135	        if let fraction = progress.fraction {
   136	            if bar.isIndeterminate {
   137	                bar.stopAnimation(nil)
   138	                bar.isIndeterminate = false
   139	            }
   140	            bar.doubleValue = fraction
   141	        } else {
   142	            bar.startAnimation(nil)
   143	        }
   144	        detailLabel.stringValue = Self.detail(for: progress)
   145	    }
   146	}

     3	/// The agent's media tools: the three `media` rows of spec §6's op table plus
     4	/// `import_media`, the one an agent actually wants — `add_media` takes a
     5	/// descriptor somebody has to have probed, and probing files is the host's job
     6	/// (spec §7.7).
     7	extension AgentServer {
     8	
     9	    // MARK: - Importing
    10	
    11	    /// `import_media` — File ▸ Add Media… and every Finder drop
    12	    /// (`ProjectDocument.importMedia`): probe the file, then `add_media`.
    13	    /// With `set_video {look: {kind: "lut", media}}` after it, it mirrors the
    14	    /// Look section's Import LUT… (`EditorViewController.importLUT`, GR-8).
    15	    ///
    16	    /// **Runs on the server thread** (`AgentServer.offMainTools`).
    17	    /// `MediaImporter.probe`'s completion is delivered on the MAIN thread, so
    18	    /// a main-thread wait for it would deadlock; waiting here leaves main free
    19	    /// to deliver it, exactly as `ProjectDocument.readMediaFile` waits on
    20	    /// NSDocument's background read queue.
    21	    ///
    22	    /// **The new media id is the project's `next_id` from BEFORE the op** —
    23	    /// the documented contract (`ReelOp.addMedia`), because there is one FFI
    24	    /// entry point for every op (spec §11) and it returns a project, not a
    25	    /// value. The id is read off the snapshot first and cross-checked against
    26	    /// what the edit actually added.
    27	    func importMedia(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
    28	        let path = try requiredString(a, "path")
    29	        let url = URL(fileURLWithPath: (path as NSString).expandingTildeInPath)
    30	        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) else {
    31	            throw ToolError(message: "No file at \(url.path)")
    32	        }
    33	        let document = try onMain { try self.target(a) }
    34	        let descriptor = try probe(url)
    35	        return try onMain {
    36	            let expected = document.project.snapshot.nextId
    37	            let before = try self.performGroupedEdit(
    38	                document, "Add Media", [.addMedia(descriptor: descriptor)])
    39	            let added = ProjectSnapshot.addedMedia(from: before, to: document.project.snapshot)
    40	            document.generateCaches()
    41	            var result: [String: Any] = [

    80	    /// the re-encode). `import_media` and `relink_media` both wait this long.

    84	    /// Probes one file and waits for the answer. MUST run off the main thread
    85	    /// — see `importMedia` — and gives up only after `probeCeiling`: a file
    86	    /// AVFoundation cannot read may be converted by ffmpeg first
    87	    /// (`FFmpegRewrap.assist`), which legitimately takes as long as
    88	    /// `FFmpegRewrap.longestAssist`, so a shorter wait would answer a
    89	    /// timeout while the conversion is still running. A tool call never
    90	    /// asks the conversion question (spec §11 MC-5), so it passes
    91	    /// `mayAsk: false`, and a refusal ffmpeg could have helped names the
    92	    /// setting (`neverAsksSentence`).
    93	    private func probe(_ url: URL) throws -> MediaDescriptor {
    94	        guard !Thread.isMainThread else {
    95	            throw ToolError(message: "Probing cannot run on the main thread.")
    96	        }
    97	        let semaphore = DispatchSemaphore(value: 0)
    98	        let box = AgentBox<Result<MediaDescriptor, any Error>>()
    99	        MediaImporter.probe(url: url, mayAsk: false) { result in
   100	            box.value = result
   101	            semaphore.signal()
   102	        }
   103	        guard semaphore.wait(timeout: .now() + Self.probeCeiling) == .success else {
   104	            throw ToolError(message: "Timed out reading \(url.lastPathComponent).")
   105	        }
   106	        guard let outcome = box.value else {
   107	            throw ToolError(message: "Could not read \(url.lastPathComponent).")
   108	        }
   109	        do {
   110	            return try outcome.get()
   111	        } catch {
   112	            guard let sentence = Self.neverAsksSentence(for: error, url: url) else {
   113	                throw ToolError(message: error.localizedDescription)
   114	            }
   115	            throw ToolError(message: error.localizedDescription + " " + sentence)
   116	        }
   117	    }

   197	        } catch let error as MediaConsolidator.ConsolidateError {
   198	            guard case .untitled = error else {
   199	                throw ToolError(message: error.localizedDescription)
   200	            }
   201	            throw ToolError(
   202	                message: error.localizedDescription + " Call save_project with a path first.")
   203	        } catch {

   207	        // caller asked for, and `editResult` would report the empty op list
   208	        // as a refusal.
   209	        guard !plan.isEmpty else {
   210	            return try jsonResult([
   211	                "ok": true, "copied": 0, "directory": plan.directory.path,
   212	                "missing": plan.missing,
   213	                "note": "Every file this project can find is already inside the package.",
   214	                "project": summary(document),

     1	//! What a WebM or Matroska track's codec becomes in a QuickTime movie (spec
     2	//! §11 #216-R): its four-character code, and the setup record the writer's
     3	//! format description carries.
     4	//!
     5	//! - **Video.** `V_VP9` is `vp09` with a `vpcC` built here from the first
     6	//!   keyframe's uncompressed header and the track's Colour element, because
     7	//!   ffmpeg writes no VP9 CodecPrivate (measured) and the decoder needs one.
     8	//!   `V_AV1`, `V_MPEG4/ISO/AVC` and `V_MPEGH/ISO/HEVC` are `av01`, `avc1` and
     9	//!   `hvc1`, their CodecPrivate already being the `av1C`, `avcC` and `hvcC`
    10	//!   record. `V_VP8` is `vp08`, named so the app can refuse it in #216's
    11	//!   sentence. Anything else is not copied.
    12	//! - **Audio.** `A_OPUS` is `opus` with OpusHead verbatim as its cookie.
    13	//!   `A_VORBIS` is `vorb` with its CodecPrivate, the three Xiph-laced
    14	//!   headers, verbatim as its cookie — AVFoundation's own Ogg reader's
    15	//!   layout (measured) — when `container_vorbis.rs` can read the headers
    16	//!   (spec §11 #228-V). `A_AAC` is `aac ` with an ES_Descriptor around the
    17	//!   AudioSpecificConfig: a bare AudioSpecificConfig wrote a movie with NO
    18	//!   audio track and no error (measured). `A_AAC/MPEG4/*`, with no
    19	//!   CodecPrivate, a Vorbis track whose headers cannot be read, and every
    20	//!   other codec are not copied — the app names them and the opt-in ffmpeg
    21	//!   step may take them.
    22	//! - **Opus packet lengths** come from the TOC byte (RFC 6716 §3.1), because
    23	//!   a 60 ms packet timed at a fixed 960 samples mistimes the track
    24	//!   (measured).

    26	use crate::container_vorbis::Vorbis;
    27	
    28	/// The Colour element's four values the `vpcC` record carries, and its
    29	/// HDR10 fields (spec §11 HD-18 (a), RFC 9559): MaxCLL, MaxFALL and the
    30	/// MasteringMetadata, which a PQ copy's description carries as `mdcv` and
    31	/// `clli`.
    32	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
    33	pub(crate) struct Colour {
    34	    pub matrix: Option<u8>,
    35	    pub range: Option<u8>,
    36	    pub transfer: Option<u8>,
    37	    pub primaries: Option<u8>,
    38	    pub max_cll: Option<u64>,
    39	    pub max_fall: Option<u64>,
    40	    pub mastering: Option<Mastering>,
    41	}
    42	
    43	/// A MasteringMetadata element's floats: each primary's and the white
    44	/// point's CIE 1931 x and y, and the luminance range in cd/m². An absent
    45	/// child is 0.
    46	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
    47	pub(crate) struct Mastering {
    48	    pub red: (f64, f64),
    49	    pub green: (f64, f64),
    50	    pub blue: (f64, f64),
    51	    pub white: (f64, f64),
    52	    pub luminance_max: f64,
    53	    pub luminance_min: f64,
    54	}
    55	
    56	/// ST 2086's chromaticity unit (0.00002) and luminance unit (0.0001 cd/m²).
    57	const CHROMATICITY_UNITS: f64 = 50_000.0;
    58	const LUMINANCE_UNITS: f64 = 10_000.0;
    59	
    60	/// `value × units` rounded to nearest and clamped to `0…max`; NaN or a
    61	/// negative value is 0.
    62	fn fixed(value: f64, units: f64, max: u64) -> u64 {
    63	    if value.is_nan() || value <= 0.0 {
    64	        return 0;
    65	    }
    66	    let scaled = (value * units).round();
    67	    if scaled >= max as f64 {
    68	        max
    69	    } else {
    70	        scaled as u64
    71	    }
    72	}
    73	
    74	/// The `MasteringDisplayColorVolume` blob (spec §11 HD-12, HD-18 (a)): the
    75	/// primaries in ST 2086's and H.265 SEI 137's order — green, blue, red —
    76	/// then the white point, each x and y a big-endian u16 in 0.00002 units
    77	/// clamped to 50000; then the maximum and minimum luminance, each a
    78	/// big-endian u32 in 0.0001 cd/m².
    79	pub(crate) fn mdcv(m: &Mastering) -> [u8; 24] {
    80	    let mut out = [0u8; 24];
    81	    let points = [m.green, m.blue, m.red, m.white];
    82	    for (i, (x, y)) in points.iter().enumerate() {
    83	        for (j, c) in [x, y].iter().enumerate() {
    84	            let v = fixed(**c, CHROMATICITY_UNITS, 50_000) as u16;
    85	            out[i * 4 + j * 2..i * 4 + j * 2 + 2].copy_from_slice(&v.to_be_bytes());
    86	        }
    87	    }

    89	    let min = fixed(m.luminance_min, LUMINANCE_UNITS, u64::from(u32::MAX)) as u32;

    91	    out[20..24].copy_from_slice(&min.to_be_bytes());
    92	    out
    93	}

    96	/// a big-endian u16 clamped to 65535, an absent one 0.
    97	pub(crate) fn clli(max_cll: Option<u64>, max_fall: Option<u64>) -> [u8; 4] {
    98	    let level = |v: Option<u64>| v.unwrap_or(0).min(u64::from(u16::MAX)) as u16;
    99	    let mut out = [0u8; 4];
   100	    out[0..2].copy_from_slice(&level(max_cll).to_be_bytes());
   101	    out[2..4].copy_from_slice(&level(max_fall).to_be_bytes());
   102	    out
   103	}

   106	/// the MasteringMetadata floats (G, B, R, the white point, each x and y in
   107	/// 0.00002; the maximum and minimum luminance in 0.0001 cd/m²). `None` for
   108	/// any other length. The WebM writer's Colour (spec §11 CX-15 (3)).
   109	pub(crate) fn mastering_from_mdcv(b: &[u8]) -> Option<Mastering> {
   110	    let b: &[u8; 24] = b.try_into().ok()?;
   111	    let u16_at = |i: usize| f64::from(u16::from_be_bytes([b[i], b[i + 1]]));
   112	    let u32_at = |i: usize| f64::from(u32::from_be_bytes([b[i], b[i + 1], b[i + 2], b[i + 3]]));
   113	    let point = |i: usize| {
   114	        (
   115	            u16_at(i) / CHROMATICITY_UNITS,
   116	            u16_at(i + 2) / CHROMATICITY_UNITS,
   117	        )
   118	    };

   120	        green: point(0),
   121	        blue: point(4),
   122	        red: point(8),
   123	        white: point(12),
   124	        luminance_max: u32_at(16) / LUMINANCE_UNITS,
   125	        luminance_min: u32_at(20) / LUMINANCE_UNITS,
   126	    })
   127	}

   134	        u64::from(u16::from_be_bytes([b[0], b[1]])),
   135	        u64::from(u16::from_be_bytes([b[2], b[3]])),
   136	    ))
   137	}

#!/bin/sh
# Runs Frame Job's ffmpeg arguments over a sound file with cover art, and asks
# AVFoundation about FLAC and CAF. Scratch folder only.
D=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-kevingalligan-devel-framejob/9cfd7405-83ec-4caa-905f-7b97a20f2cc9/scratchpad/work/p3
rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; cd "$D" || exit 1
ffmpeg -nostdin -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=1" a.wav
ffmpeg -nostdin -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i "color=c=red:s=64x64" -frames:v 1 c.png
ffmpeg -nostdin -loglevel error -y -i a.wav -i c.png -map 0 -map 1 -c:a flac -c:v copy -disposition:v attached_pic s.flac
ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=codec_type,codec_name:stream_disposition=attached_pic -of csv=p=0 s.flac
echo "--- the plan's arguments, a re-encoded sound and no video option"
ffmpeg -nostdin -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i s.flac -map '0:v:0?' -map '0:a:0?' -dn -sn -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart -f mov out.mov
ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=codec_type,codec_name -of csv=p=0 out.mov
afconvert -f caff -d LEI16 a.wav a.caf
ffmpeg -nostdin -loglevel error -y -i a.wav -c:a flac a.flac
cat > probe.swift <<'EOF'
import AVFoundation
let sem = DispatchSemaphore(value: 0)
Task {
    for p in CommandLine.arguments.dropFirst() {
        let a = AVURLAsset(url: URL(fileURLWithPath: p))
        let d = try? await a.load(.duration)
        let v = (try? await a.loadTracks(withMediaType: .video)) ?? []
        let s = (try? await a.loadTracks(withMediaType: .audio)) ?? []
        print(p, d?.seconds ?? -1, "video", v.count, "audio", s.count)
    }
    sem.signal()
}
sem.wait()
EOF
swift probe.swift "$D/a.caf" "$D/a.flac" "$D/out.mov"

3:A Frame Job project is a `.framejob` package: one file in the Finder that holds the edit, the caches that make it quick to reopen, and, when you ask for it, copies of the footage itself. This page covers starting a project (most often by opening a movie), saving it, what is inside the package, the canvas settings on the Document tab, bringing files in, the Media tab, and what to do when files go missing.
152:| Sound | M4A (AAC, ALAC), MP3, WAV and AIFF everywhere. Other formats macOS plays, such as CAF and FLAC, import when dropped on the Media tab. |
177:- If the copy is later deleted, or moved to the Trash, the project makes it again from the original the next time it opens. If that copy is cancelled or fails, the file shows as missing (a slate, the **missing** badge, Relink…) until the next open tries again.
178:- Frame Job never deletes anything from the Rewrapped folder, which every project shares, so copies pile up there. You can clear it: WebM and MKV copies are made again on the next open (ffmpeg conversions are not; see below).
234:A new clip is the whole file, as long as the file runs. A picture is 5 seconds long. With **Fit new clips to canvas** on, a file larger than the canvas is scaled to fit. A LUT row cannot be dragged or placed; it is applied as a look instead. What insert and overwrite do to the clips around them is covered in [Editing](editing.md).
258:Removing media never deletes the file from disk.
292:- A screen recording's cursor file is copied too, next to its movie and named after it (`Recording.mov` and `Recording.fjcursor`), and counts as one of the files copied. It is copied only once its movie is, and the project points at the copy only once it is there: a cursor file that cannot be copied is listed with the files that could not be, and the recording keeps its original cursor file. A cursor file that is missing is left alone ("1 cursor file was missing and left alone.").
